scenario_context: Payment failed but customer sees debit. Likely pending authorization. Reassure, confirm pending vs posted, avoid sensitive data requests, provide timeline and escalation path.

customer_profile.opening_message: My payment failed but the money is already deducted.
customer_profile.secret_condition: Customer accepts if agent explains pending vs posted + gives timeline and follow-up plan

checkpoints.description: Acknowledge concern and reassure you will help
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Start with empathy—money issues feel urgent.

checkpoints.description: Collect minimal transaction details and confirm pending vs posted
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Ask amount, timestamp, and pending/posted status.

checkpoints.description: Explain authorization hold in simple language without dismissing
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Clarify it may reverse automatically, but you’ll track it.

checkpoints.description: Share realistic timeline and what happens next
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Give a clear expectation window + next update time.

checkpoints.description: Escalate if posted/settled or beyond SLA, and confirm follow-up
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Offer billing review if it doesn’t resolve in time.

success_summary: Customer reassured with pending-vs-posted explanation, realistic timeline, and clear follow-up plan.
